# Ecosystem for Kids

> > Educational science platform offering interactive games, quizzes, and diagrams for elementary students covering biology, earth science, geography, and natural ecosystems.

Ecosystem for Kids provides grade-specific learning activities (K-8) focused on life cycles, animal classification, earth processes, geography, and biological systems. The site features interactive labeling games, science quizzes, and hands-on lesson plans covering topics from cellular biology to global geography.

## Key Topics

- Interactive learning games
- Elementary science education
- Life cycles (fish, ants, bees)
- Animal classification (mammals, fish, amphibians, birds)
- Earth science and water cycle
- Geography (continents, United States, Europe, Africa, Asia)
- Biology diagrams and anatomy
- Fossils and extinction
- Pollination and ecosystems
- Human skeleton and cellular structure
- Rock types and geology
- Grade-specific quizzes (2nd-8th grade)
- Labelled scientific diagrams
- Atomic structure
- Forest ecosystems and biodiversity

## Interactive Science Games & Diagrams

- [Diagram of the water cycle - labelled diagram](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/games/diagram-of-the-water-cycle.html): Interactive water cycle diagram for grades 1-7 showing Earth processes
- [Diagram of a fish - labelled diagram of a fish](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/games/diagram-of-a-fish.html): Interactive fish anatomy labeling game for elementary biology students
- [Labeled human skeleton game quiz online](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/games/labeled-human-skeleton.html): Interactive quiz on 206-bone human skeletal system anatomy
- [Animal classification game for 2nd grade kids](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/games/2nd-grade/classify-mammals-fish-amphibian/activity.html): 2nd grade animal classification rally game for mammals, fish, birds

## Life Cycles & Biology

- [The Life Cycle Of A Fish Online Game](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/life-cycles/life-cycle-of-a-fish.html): Online game teaching fish life cycle from eggs to salmon development
- [Honey Bee Facts For Kids - Life Cycle & Habitat](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/honey-bee-facts-for-kids.html): Honey bee facts covering Apis genus, life cycle, and Eurasian habitat
- [Life Cycle Of An Ant Science Quiz For Kids Online](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/quizzes/2nd-grade/Life-Cycle-Of-An-Ant/online.html): 2nd grade ant life cycle labeling quiz
- [The Pollination Process of a Flower](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/the-pollination-process-of-a-flower.html): Guide to flower pollination types and pollinator roles
- [Animal Cell Model: Cellular Structure](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/animal-cell-model.html): Animal cell structure with Amoeba, Euglena, Mitochondrion examples
- [Interesting Facts About Mosquitoes For Kids](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/facts-about-mosquitoes-for-kids.html): Mosquito facts including Aedes aegypti, diseases per WHO data

## Geography & Earth Science

- [Geography For Kids | Geography Games | Geography Quiz](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/geography.html): Geography games hub covering US, Europe, Africa, Asia, Canada maps
- [Continents With Names Game Quiz Online](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/continents-with-names-game.html): Seven continents quiz for grades 5-8: Asia, Africa, Americas, Europe
- [How Does a Compass Work? Science activity for students](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/how-a-compass-works.html): Magnetic compass navigation activity with compass rose and needle basics

## Ecosystems & Environmental Science

- [Student Exploration Forest Ecosystems](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/student-exploration-forest-ecosystem.html): Forest ecosystem exploration covering biodiversity and food chains
- [Extinction and fossils, games and worksheets for kids](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/extinction-and-fossils.html): Fossilization and extinction worksheets featuring Diplodocus dinosaurs
- [Practical Lesson for Kids About Fossils](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/practical-lesson-for-kids-about-fossils.html): Hands-on fossil paleontology lesson with plaster casting activity

## Physical Science & Materials

- [Science Quiz On Atoms, Questions & Answers](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/atoms.html): Atomic structure quiz on protons, neutrons, electrons for grades 4-6
- [Identification Of Rock Types Science Quiz Online](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/quizzes/2nd-grade/Identify-Rock-Types/online.html): Rock identification quiz covering quartz, granite, slate, coal types
- [Materials and their properties science quiz online](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/quizzes/3rd-grade/materials/online.html): 3rd grade materials properties quiz on object composition

## Optional

- [Cane Chair - Timeless Elegance and Airy Charm](https://www.ecosystemforkids.com/cane-chair.html): Care tips for cane chairs including Peacock & Plantation styles
